name: Adventurer's Guild, Foyer
desc1: This is the main entrance to the renowned Adventurer's Guild of
desc2: Silvermere. You notice a strange old man sitting off to the side,
desc3: speaking in strange murmurs to himself. Every so often he stares at
desc4: you and smiles warmly, with what seems to be a look of respect. To
desc5: your east, through the flickering of lamplight, lies the common room.
desc6: From here you can hear the jumbled voices of a multitude of people.
desc7: To the west, you can leave the Guild through the main doors.
